content:
chris: quick heads-up — ran compact-kv prototype on qwen-70b mix config. reduced KV memory but saw p99 regressions.

maya: details?

chris: short log:
```
profiler: kv_cache_before=11.2GB
profiler: kv_cache_after=8.1GB  # -27.7%
profiler: p50=18ms -> 19ms (+5.6%)
profiler: p95=42ms -> 48ms (+14.3%)
profiler: p99=82ms -> 95ms (+15.9%)
profiler: eviction_rate 0.6% -> 2.1%
```

zhen: what exactly did you change in format?

chris: keys packed into 32-bit indices, values stored as contiguous fp16 blocks w/ 8-bit scale per slab (hybrid quant). removed per-head padding. also switched kernel selector to memory-first path for KV hits.

alex: eviction increase explains p99. probably prefetch window too aggressive with compacted layout — misses are more expensive now.

maya: can you paste the config snippet you used?

chris: config:
```
quantized_kv: true
kv_precision: fp16
kv_value_packing: slab32
per_slab_scale_bits: 8
prefetch_window: 128  # baseline was 256
kernel_route: memory_first
```

perf-bot: nightly-sweep report: qwen-70b compact-kv run failed p99 SLO on 4/6 hosts; mean token throughput stable.

zhen: two quick experiments: 1) try bf16 values (no scale) to see if conversion cost is the cause; 2) lower prefetch to 64 so eviction pulse less bursty.

chris: I ran bf16 locally — mem reduction only ~12% but p99 back to 86ms. looks promising.

alex: BF16 keeps arithmetic fast. fp16+per-slab scaling adds decode overhead on miss/hot-path.

maya: can we try hybrid: bf16 for hot slabs, fp16-quant for cold slabs? auto-tiering by access freq.

chris: yes — experiment scheduled. I'll toggle slab-tiering threshold from 0.02 -> 0.1 and run on 2 hosts.

perf-bot: job 4827 queued

alex: also consider changing kernel scheduling: prefer compute-bound kernels when slab packing causes misaligned loads. we saw better coalescing on Mistral layouts.

zhen: quick checklist:
- run bf16 hybrid on 2 hosts
- run smaller prefetch (64)
- collect sampleprof and kv-miss-stack traces
- add metric: decode_cpu_ms per eviction

maya: sounds good. chris, drop results in this thread when done.

chris: will do. thanks.

alex: :thumbsup:

zhen: ack
